scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the + control next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.
The requested cart update was completed.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag, entered the lowercase promo code welcome10, and applied it.
The promotion was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.
